source_caption:
Snowfall follows Franklin Saint, an ambitious young man from South Central Los Angeles who becomes involved in the crack cocaine trade during the 1980s. As his business grows, he gains money and power but is also drawn into a dangerous world of violence, betrayal, and moral compromise that changes his life and community.

In Snowfall, multiple storylines connect street dealers, law enforcement agents, and international players linked to the drug trade. The series explores themes of ambition, family, corruption, and the devastating social impact of drugs. Praised for its intense storytelling and strong performances, it has become one of the most acclaimed modern crime dramas.
